question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given word.

Dilemma
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"dilemma"** means a situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two or more alternatives, especially ones that are equally undesirable. (दुविधा)
 
 
• **Example:** She faced a dilemma about whether to accept the job offer or pursue further studies.
 
 
 
• **"Plight"** refers to a dangerous, difficult, or otherwise unfortunate situation. (मुसीबत)
 
 
• **Example:** The plight of the refugees was heartbreaking.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Portion** (हिस्सा): A part of a whole.
 
 
• **Example:** He ate a large portion of the cake.
 
 
 
• **Worn** (घिसा हुआ): Damaged and shabby as a result of much use.
 
 
• **Example:** His shoes were old and worn.
 
 
 
• **Situation** (स्थिति): A set of circumstances in which one finds oneself.
 
 
• **Example:** The situation is under control.
